_meta.description: Product ingredient lists captured verbatim from manufacturer product pages. Ingredient order is preserved exactly as displayed. Order does NOT imply concentration.
_meta.retrievalMethod: Manufacturer page fetched via Firecrawl relay (Shopify product JSON for shcbeauty.com; verbatim-quote extraction for other brands).
_meta.rightsNote: Ingredient lists are factual label declarations. Marketing copy is NOT stored except short excerpts needed for claim-language review of Supernatural's own products.
